topics.title: Asian Phase 1 Trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH Cirrhosis Patients – PEC Content Endorsement (Not Endorsed)

background.text: Topic presented for content endorsement at PEC on 15 Dec 2025. PEC raised concerns on: (1) value of enrolling limited Chinese patients; (2) increased resource and operational complexity under scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA request Asian data); (3) clarity of the two consultation questions, including whether intensive PK could be waived through this Asian Phase 1.
background.quote:
PEC suggested team to evaluate the value by enrollment of limited Chinese patients, and the invested resource and operational complexity increased under scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA request Asian data)
PEC suggested team to clearly clarify the two questions for consultation, and if an intensive PK could be waived through this Asian phase 1.

for_endorsement.text: Asian Phase 1 trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH cirrhosis patients submitted to PEC for content endorsement.

decision.text: PEC did not endorse the proposal. An ad hoc PEC meeting will be planned for further endorsement.
decision.quote:
Not Endorsed
PEC comments:
PEC suggested team to evaluate the value by enrollment of limited Chinese patients, and the invested resource and operational complexity increased under scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA request Asian data)
PEC suggested team to clearly clarify the two questions for consultation, and if an intensive PK could be waived through this Asian phase 1.
An ad hoc PEC meeting will be planned for further endorsement.
